correctness.rationale: All m≥1 reduce, by an explicit modal structural induction, to at most 64 support states. The five-formula truth signatures yield exactly eight fibers. Exhaustive 256-input closure (with a saved input-output table) proves those fibers form a closed finite modal algebra and are individually definable; their minimum support sizes give the exact 2/6/8 pointed types and therefore 4/64/256 formula equivalence classes. A separate direct all-valuations checker confirms widths 1–4, and depth-one has only 2 or 4 theories, proving the sharp depth-two bound. Finite checks are not substituted for the support induction.

value.rationale: The disjunctive knowing-whether operator is a natural multi-agent epistemic observation. Its exact one-generator Boolean algebra for an entire unbounded family of product frames, with a sharp three-column threshold and depth-two normal forms, isolates a genuine loss of expressivity caused by bundling; this is a motivated complete classification and useful finite benchmark, not an arbitrary fixed-size census. No claim beyond the specified row count or language is made.
